title: Model Horizon Heatmap and Enterprise Procurement Decision Slate
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable product-grade research and operational playbook that converts heterogeneous market signals (latency, regional availability, pricing, SLA, quantization support, vendor release cadence) into a ranked 'procurement decision slate' for enterprise sales and SREs. Output: heatmap dashboard, procurement decision rules, and a prioritized provider fallback roster.
background: Sales and platform teams increasingly ask for precise guidance when recommending model providers to customers. Existing intelligence is ad-hoc: scattered benchmark sheets, handoff notes, and anecdotal latency observations. We need a structured artifact that reconciles telemetry, public provider signals, and commercial constraints to accelerate procurement conversations and reduce switch cost surprises.
success_metrics: 1) Dashboard coverage: heatmap for top 12 providers across 8 regions and 6 signals. 2) Reduce average vendor evaluation cycle from 10 days to 3 days. 3) Field validation: 3 closed pilot deals used the slate as primary procurement rationale. 4) Engineering: automated telemetry pipeline delivering nightly availability/latency deltas.
tasks: Kickoff workshop with Sales, SRE, and Research to align signals and thresholds — owner: Jordan Blake
Define canonical signal schema (latency P50/P95, availability, price/token, quantization support, on‑prem availability, legal restrictions) — owner: Luca Martinez
Instrument telemetry sweep over 6 weeks for 12 providers across 8 regions with synthetic RAG and chat workloads — owner: Platform Research
Run focused vendor interviews to capture roadmap cadence, on‑prem pricing, and contract terms — owner: Maya Chen (Solutions)
Prototype heatmap dashboard in Console with per‑provider drilldowns and change alerts — owner: Console UX
Draft procurement decision rules (score weighting, hard thresholds, fallback escalation) and circulate for legal/finance review — owner: Aisha Kapoor
Validate slate with two enterprise pilot customers and capture decision outcomes and objections — owner: Sales AE pair
Automate nightly ingestion and anomaly alerts; wire to Ops runbook for fallback activation — owner: SRE
Finalize playbook doc, create PRD and enablement slide deck for sales — owner: Product Marketing
research_plan: Primary signals: active telemetry (synthetic workloads), provider status pages/SLAs, pricing APIs, sales interviews, and legal contract surveys. Secondary signals: community reports, public incident timelines, and third‑party benchmarks. Methodology: collect normalized metrics, backfill 3 months of trends where possible, compute weighted scorecard. Document assumptions and sensitivity analyses for weighting.
